high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "lindsaymariebrewer," taken 10 hours prior to the screenshot being captured. The photo shows two individuals standing close together outdoors during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, as indicated by the soft, warm lighting and the gradient sky transitioning from light blue to orange near the horizon. The person on the left is dressed in a light beige suit with a white dress shirt underneath. They have short dark hair and are holding a glass of what looks like white wine in their right hand.
